title: You Cast Level 4 Ban
description: You Cast Level 4 Ban — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_A

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Slay the Banned Farmers in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag again and then return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 4 King's Coins

Return to: QuestGiver_A

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Slay the Banned Farmers in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag again and then return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

By now your ban level has to be maxed out, which is perfect timing because we need you to get back in there and smack down more of these blasted farmers. iVan has been relentless, but we haven't given an inch and I don't plan on backing down now.

I want you to hit every level of Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and wipe out each of the Banned Farmers you see. When you have done this return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

I bow down to you, Dungeon Runner. No one has wielded the ban stick so righteously and with such ferocity! Let me know if you want to try this quest again.

Objectives:

  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 1
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 1 Branch
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 2
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 3
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 3 Branch
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 4
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 4 Branch

Client level range: 93–100
